'''2007 Ohio State Championship Kendall Halman LS Watch Your Step''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Kendall Halman]] at [[2007 Ohio State Championship]].

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Watch Your Step / This Place Can Be A Little Rough|Ref2-L-watchyourstep.gif}}
* '''Name on sheet:''' Kendell Holman
* '''Deck name:''' Unmodifiable values
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS12]]
